custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with 2 in its bin and a Core Charge of $25.00, so it has a core.
  • Use a computer that can open the exported file in a spreadsheet program.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Replace the search text with Core for followed by part A's description.
  2. Replace the search text with part A's part number.
  3. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Export.
  5. Open the downloaded file from your browser's downloads list.
  6. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  7. Click Deactivate parts.
  8. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  9. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
